description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2107 / PL.03 (Rev 01); 2107 / PL.04 (Rev 01)  Received:  30 July 2021;  2107 / PL.00; 2107 / PL.01; 2107 / PL.02  Received:  02 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill extension hereby approved.
